ResearchProjectDef.label: Upstairs
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a basic staircase leading to an upper floor that can house pawns.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Downstairs
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a basic staircase leading to a lower floor that can house pawns. Downstairs are naturally insulated.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Mountain Upfloor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a staircase leading to an upper floor carved into the mountain overhead. These upfloors are naturally insulated by the surrounding rock and can only be built under overhead mountain or rock roofs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Textile Insulation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Use textiles to insulate rooms from the elements, improving temperature regulation.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Soundproofing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Line walls and floors with sound-absorbing materials to reduce noise disturbance from other floors.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Heaters
ResearchProjectDef.description: Install heaters in rooms to maintain a comfortable temperature during cold weather.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Air Conditioners
ResearchProjectDef.description: Install air conditioners in rooms to maintain a comfortable temperature during any weather.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Gravship Staircases
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build staircases designed specifically for gravship interiors. These staircases use the gravship's substructure to create upper decks and lower decks, providing crew quarters without requiring ground-based construction.
